agent_evaluation.note: Hand-authored synthetic smoke set. It checks tool routing/citation paths, not financial correctness.

implemented_capabilities: Synthetic quarterly financials for three fictional companies
Read-only and allowlisted SQLite SQL tool
Parameter binding, SQL comment/multi-statement rejection, row cap and query execution budget
Deterministic tool planner and action/observation trace
Operating margin and revenue change calculations
Abstention for personalized investment recommendation requests
limitations: All numeric records and research notes are fictional.
The planner is deterministic and supports a finite set of question patterns.
No current market information is retrieved.
This project is not financial or investment advice.
